'''Rob Bosman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Ryloth Regionals]] on 6 August 2000 with Endor Strike Team, according to Paul van der Gun's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1096">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-8-7-00d1096/ ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-8-7-00], DeckTech (Paul "Diplomat" van der Gun, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-8-7-00d1096/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
